blocking_findings.location: .flow/specs/fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer.md R17 receipt schema and regeneration contract; .flow/tasks/fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer.2.md STEP 0 receipt schema; .flow/tasks/fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer.7.md final-gate regeneration path
blocking_findings.finding: The repaired receipt schema still makes later regeneration impossible to record truthfully. Every captures[] entry, including regenerated captures, must contain planning_worktree_state asserted to contain no product-path changes. But task .7 explicitly permits regeneration after tasks .1-.6 have implemented the feature, when the planning worktree necessarily contains product, test, dependency, lockfile, and documentation changes. The detached baseline worktree remains clean and authoritative, but the required per-capture planning-worktree assertion would be false. Canonical Grok would have to either lie in the receipt or violate the regeneration contract.
blocking_findings.required_change: Make the no-product-path-changes assertion initial-capture-only. For regenerated captures, require planning_worktree_state to record the current state truthfully, including expected implementation changes, without gating baseline validity. State explicitly that baseline provenance is established solely by the isolated detached worktree's exact base SHA, clean status, frozen-lockfile setup, and command hashes. Align the spec, task .2 schema/acceptance, task .7 regeneration instructions, and P13A/P14 repair receipt.

non_blocking_observations.observation: The vendor-route contract requires an allowlisted extension but does not enumerate it. Implementation should explicitly restrict cMaps to `.bcmap` and standard-font assets to the extensions actually required by pinned pdfjs-dist, with tests, rather than relying only on containment.

P14 is otherwise resolved: the canonical baseline-compared command list is identical everywhere—`bun run lint:check`, `bunx tsc --noEmit`, `bun test`, `bun run test:web`, `bun run docs:verify`—and all new e2e, package, focused-new-test, and P-1…P-6 gates are absolute-pass.

coverage_summary: Full current-artifact review completed. P1-P12 and P14 remain materially resolved. The seven-task DAG, R1-R19 mapping, PDF.js facade/import boundary, React StrictMode and stale-load lifecycle, progressive rendering, virtualization, cancellation, bounded canvases and DPR area cap, content-free bounded metrics, deterministic P-1…P-6 evidence, real PDF fixtures, same-origin worker/cMap/font delivery, installed-package smoke, Range handling, realpath/symlink containment, CSP/framing preservation, inert scripting and unsafe links, fallback/deep-link behavior, accessibility, responsive Scholarly Dusk states, documentation, and no-publication boundary are executable. P13A is only partially resolved: the unified append-only captures[] schema, unique capture IDs, exact-base isolated worktree, and truthful initial planning state are present, but the schema imposes an impossible no-product-change assertion on post-implementation regeneration. Implementation must wait for that contradiction to be repaired.
